CVE-2026-103433.title: Docker Buildx Bake does not request the expected fs.read approval ...
CVE-2026-103433.description: Docker Buildx Bake does not request the expected fs.read approval for certain filesystem inputs. An untrusted Bake definition can expose a readable file through a pathless secret whose ID is interpreted as a client-side pathname, or consume a local OCI image layout outside the project after entitlement validation checks a different path representation. Users who run untrusted Bake definitions are affected.
